previewMethod: Compared the three public official stills with each upload's player seek previews, which are 80 × 36 and sampled every two seconds. Pearson RGB correlations use 36 × 20 pixels after trimming black bars. The times below refer to the closest visual sample within six seconds of each previously matched official still. The second column of samples belongs to the separate comparison upload.

crossUploadComparison.method: Compared each of the 81 selected-upload seek thumbnails against all 82 comparison-upload thumbnails. A match required the strongest RGB correlation anywhere in the second timeline to exceed 0.85 and fall within two seconds of the first timestamp. The displayed pairs below are drawn from those 17 matches. Values use the complete thumbnail resized to 36 × 20.

finding: The native repost was published 48 minutes after the official Korean premiere and seven days before the white-studio choreography version. Title, duration, set, costumes and matching shot order identify the premiere edit. The seek previews are too sparse to claim pixel-identical frames at all three reference times. In particular the selected upload's 80-second preview already shows a group shot. Playback and decoded resolution are verified separately in the browser.
